decision.explanation: The source documents contain two distinct assertions regarding the membership of the Hoboken Public Library. Document 1 (specifically D1S5) explicitly states the library is a member of the 'Urban Libraries Council'. Document 2 (specifically D2S2) asserts the library joined the 'Academy of Sciences of Turin'. Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers without resolving contradictions silently, both organizations are included as they are directly supported by the provided text segments as memberships.
